title: Lazar sees flying saucer in S4 hangar
summary: Bob Lazar tells of Lazar sees flying saucer in S4 hangar, about 1988-1989 at Nevada test site and Area 51, and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I went into the hangar door and in the hangar door was the disc, the flying saucer. This is technology that doesn't even exist.

plain: Bob Lazar says that in 1988 and 1989 he worked at S4, a hidden facility he places near Area 51, the secret US Air Force base in the Nevada desert. He tells podcast host Jesse Michels that he walked up to a hangar door and saw a disc inside, a flying saucer. He says it was technology that does not even exist, which, if true, would mean the government holds craft not made by people.
